reddit.title: Improved Audio Experience in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We've made some exciting updates to the audio experience in Provincia! The music now transitions smoothly without hard cuts, thanks to a new crossfade system. This means no more jarring interruptions during gameplay. Check out the full details on our devtalk here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
